definitions.short: Eliezer , the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites
definitions.full: H461. Eliezer אֱלִיעֶ֫זֶר ( עֶֿ֑זרֶ Gen 15:2 +) proper name, masculine ( God is help , compare Exod 18:4 ; see also אֶלְעָזָר below, עֲזַרְאֵל , Phoenician עזרבעל בעלעזר, אשמנעזר, ) a. Abraham's steward ( אֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר ), a Damascene Gen 15:2 . b. a son of Moses Exod 18:4 ; 1Chr 23:15 , 17 (twice in verse). c. Benjamite 1Chr 7:8 . d. several priests 1Chr 15:24 ; 26:25 ; Ezek 10:18 . e. Reubenite 1Chr 27:16 . f. prophet in time of Jehoshaphat 2Chr 20:37 . g. Levite chief Ezek 8:16 ; Ezekiel 10:23. h. son of Harim Ezra 10:31 .
